issues.description: Clause 1.2 is internally inconsistent. It states a term of five (5) years (60 months) starting 1 August 2025, but gives an end date of 31 July 2029, which is only four years (48 months). A five-year term from 1 August 2025 would end on 31 July 2030. The stated values (60 months and 2029-07-31) have been recorded as written. Please confirm the correct term and expiry date with the parties.
Option exercise notice is at least 3 months before the end of the term. The exercise deadline depends on the correct expiry date, which is in conflict (see the term/expiry issue).
